description: This file is a JavaScript module defining a controller for a TodoMVC application, containing methods for managing todo items such as create, remove, update, toggle all, and count updates. It appears to be part of the application's business logic in the frontend.

methods.name: createTodo
methods.description: Creates a new todo item; implementation not provided

methods.name: removeTodo
methods.description: Removes an existing todo item; implementation not provided

methods.name: updateTodo
methods.description: Updates an existing todo item; implementation not provided

methods.name: beginEditTodo
methods.description: Starts inline editing mode for a specific todo DOM node, focusing the input field

methods.name: endEditTodo
methods.description: Finishes editing a todo; removes it if its text is empty, otherwise updates it

methods.name: removeCompleted
methods.description: Removes all completed todos from the list

methods.name: toggleAll
methods.description: Checks or unchecks all todos based on the master checkbox

methods.name: updateCount
methods.description: Updates total, checked, remaining, and toggles master checkbox state

methods.name: updateTotalCount
methods.description: Updates the total count of todos; implementation not provided

methods.name: updateCompletedCount
methods.description: Updates the count of completed todos in the DOM

methods.name: updateRemainingCount(nodes, value)
methods.description: Updates the remaining count by calling a self-optimizing function
